node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; const trace=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("traces.json","utf8")); const ids=new Set(); let leaves=0; function walk(nodes,prefix=""){ nodes.forEach((node,index)=>{ const expected=(prefix?prefix+".":"")+(index+1); if(node.id!==expected) throw new Error("non-positional id "+node.id+" expected "+expected); if(ids.has(node.id)) throw new Error("duplicate id "+node.id); ids.add(node.id); const branch=Array.isArray(node.children); if(branch === ("evidence" in node)) throw new Error("invalid branch/leaf "+node.id); if(branch){ if(node.children.length===0) throw new Error("empty branch "+node.id); walk(node.children,node.id); } else { if(!node.evidence?.kind || !node.evidence?.value) throw new Error("missing evidence "+node.id); if(["create_file","modify_file"].includes(node.evidence.kind)){ const changes=node.evidence.file_changes??[]; if(changes.length!==1 || changes[0].path!==node.evidence.value) throw new Error("bad file change "+node.id); } leaves+=1; } }); } walk(trace.tree); console.log("ATML positional shape: valid ("+ids.size+" nodes, "+leaves+" leaves)");'
